badgeKey.text:
WILL badge

A muted outline pill on any nav item whose screen does not exist in this design set yet — planned, not drawn.

Carrying it today: Bộ lọc cổ phiếu / Stock screener · Bản đồ nhiệt (full screen) / Heatmap · Xây chiến lược / Strategy builder · Kiểm thử lịch sử / Backtesting · Sổ giao dịch (full screen) / Trade journal. In crypto mode also: paper trading and Quant, which currently borrow the stock screens.

Deliberately grey, not amber: amber means Replay in this system, and a planned feature should not shout louder than a built one.

If the badge ships to real users, swap the word for “Sắp có” / “Coming soon” — “WILL” reads as an internal marker.

cryptoRules.text:
Stock mode vs crypto mode — what actually changes

Mode switch sits at the top of the sidebar (full nav) or as a STK/CRY pair on the icon rail. Everything below it re-skins; the layout never moves.

Gone in crypto: ceiling / reference / floor prices and their purple–yellow–cyan colours, trading sessions, lot sizes, LO / MP / ATC order types, P/E and ROE.

New in crypto: 24/7 status instead of a session clock, pairs (BTC/USDT) instead of tickers, order book with cumulative depth bars, Market / Limit / Stop / OCO, amounts in coin with USDT value, 24h high–low–volume and distance from ATH, circulating vs max supply.

Kept: green up / red down, the candle engine, Replay, the paper account, Quant.

Replay on crypto runs hourly candles and never skips a weekend; risk management is scored more strictly because volatility is far higher.

localeRules.text:
Localisation rules (EN build)

Numbers: 1,412.58 — comma thousands, dot decimal.
Dates: 22/09/2026, DD/MM — Vietnamese exchange convention kept.
Currency: 1,086,420,000 ₫ · short forms M / bn / T ₫.
Prices quoted in thousands of ₫, as on HOSE.
Tickers, exchange names and order types (LO, MP, ATC) stay untranslated.
Ceiling / Reference / Floor keep the VN colour code — the words translate, the semantics do not.

Key terms: Tổng quan → Overview · Bản đồ nhiệt → Heatmap · Giao dịch giấy → Paper trading · Sổ giao dịch → Trade journal · Vị thế → Positions · Giá vốn → Avg cost · Sụt giảm tối đa → Max drawdown · Hệ số lợi nhuận → Profit factor · Trợ lý Quant → Quant assistant.

Vietnamese labels run 15–30% longer than English: every EN artboard is the VI layout unchanged, so if it fits in VI it fits in EN.

authRules.text:
Accounts — the rules behind these screens

Guest first: Replay, charts and the screener run with no account. The sign-in prompt appears at the first paper order, because that is the first thing that needs somewhere to live.

Email and password only — accounts are created by hand. No Google, Zalo or Apple sign-in in this build; if they are added later the buttons go above the divider, and the guest button stays below it.

Starting capital is chosen at sign-up, not fixed: 1 tỷ ₫, 500 triệu ₫ or 10.000 USDT. It is the number every later return percentage is measured against, so it belongs in the sign-up form rather than in settings.

One person can hold several paper portfolios (main, a strategy test, a crypto wallet). The account menu is where they are switched, which is why portfolios sit above profile and settings in it.

No ID documents, no brokerage connection, no fees — the sign-up screen says so in the left panel rather than burying it in terms.
